# === Builtins ===

--8<-- [start:sat_1]
sat(X & Y)                # both must be 1
sat(X | Y)                # at least one must be 1
sat(~X)                     # X must be 0
sat(BoolEq(X, Y))         # X ↔ Y (equivalence)
sat(BoolImpl(X, Y))       # X → Y (implication)
--8<-- [end:sat_1]

--8<-- [start:sat_1_ex2]
sat(X | Y), sat(~X | Z), sat(Y & Z)
--8<-- [end:sat_1_ex2]

--8<-- [start:taut_2]
# De Morgan's law — tautology
taut(BoolEq(~(X & Y), ~X | ~Y), T)   # T = 1

# Contradiction
taut(X & ~X, T)                          # T = 0

# Neither (indeterminate) — taut fails
taut(X | Y, T)                            # fails
--8<-- [end:taut_2]

--8<-- [start:sat_count_2]
sat_count(X ^ Y, N)       # N = 2  (XOR has 2 solutions)
sat_count(X & Y, N)       # N = 1  (AND has 1 solution)
sat_count(X | Y, N)       # N = 3  (OR has 3 solutions)
--8<-- [end:sat_count_2]

--8<-- [start:half_adder]
half_adder(X, Y, SUM, CARRY) <- (
    sat(BoolEq(SUM, X ^ Y)),
    sat(BoolEq(CARRY, X & Y))
)
--8<-- [end:half_adder]

--8<-- [start:pigeon_hole]
pigeon_hole() <- (
    sat(P11 | P12),
    sat(P21 | P22),
    sat(P31 | P32),
    sat(~(P11 & P21)),
    sat(~(P11 & P31)),
    sat(~(P21 & P31)),
    sat(~(P12 & P22)),
    sat(~(P12 & P32)),
    sat(~(P22 & P32)),
    bool_labeling([P11, P12, P21, P22, P31, P32])
)
# no solutions
--8<-- [end:pigeon_hole]

--8<-- [start:circuit_equivalence]
taut(BoolEq(~(X & Y), ~X | ~Y), T)   # T = 1
--8<-- [end:circuit_equivalence]
